title: Palm taxi rank, Delft (approx.): two men shot dead and one wounded in suspected taxi-related shooting, 22 Oct
summary: Two men were shot dead and another person wounded at the Palm taxi rank on Main Road, Delft, in the early hours of Thursday 22 October, police said. Delft police registered two counts of murder and one of attempted murde...
story: Two men were shot dead and another person wounded at the Palm taxi rank on Main Road, Delft, in the early hours of Thursday 22 October, police said. Delft police registered two counts of murder and one of attempted murder, and police believe the motive is taxi-related. Accounts of the time differ: a resident told the Cape Times of gunfire at about 03:45 and again at 04:20, while police told Cape Town Etc the shooting was reported at about 05:10. An unnamed taxi operator quoted by the Cape Times blamed a route dispute between the taxi associations CATA and CODETA; the paper says this was not independently confirmed, and both associations said they could not comment. We found no report of an arrest (checked 11 Nov). No one is named. Police statements carried by news outlets; no SAPS statement found. The map point is approximate: the rank is not mapped, so the pin is where Palm Street meets Delft Main Road, not a confirmed spot.
incident: Thu 22 Oct 2026, early morning. A resident heard gunfire at about 03:45 and 04:20 (Cape Times); police say it was reported at about 05:10 (Cape Town Etc). Exact time not settled.

provenance.note: Casualties, charges and motive come from one police account carried by three outlets; the Cape Argus repeats the Cape Times police quote. Cape Town Etc spoke to police separately and gives the 05:10 report time. The only voices outside police are an unnamed resident (time of the gunfire) and an unnamed taxi operator whose route-dispute claim the Cape Times says was not independently confirmed. No one is named.
